name: beeftv-plugin-ysdui
description: Built-in OneAxis computing power and multi-modal channel plug-in, supports one-click synchronization of DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Hunyuan, Doubao Seedream 5.0 / Seedance 2.0 & 2.5, Wan 3.0, MiniMax H3, Hunyuan Image 3.0 and WAND-Vega image/video models by filling in the API Key.

beeftv.name: Yinshengyunshu computing power and multi-modal channels

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: Yinshengyunshu Yisheng API Key
fields.description: Fill in the sk-... key provided by Yinsheng Yunshu Yishuan (https://www.ysdui.cn))

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Yinshengyunshu calculation interface root address, default https://tokenhub.ysdui.cn

providers.label: Yinshengyunshu one calculation synchronous image generation (Seedream / Qwen / Hunyuan)

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Sync image model IDs (such as doubao-seedream-5-0-260128, doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628, qwen-image-3.0-pro, hy-image-v3.0).

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Image description prompt words.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: Reference image list (URL or Base64 Data URL), used for single image editing or multi-image fusion.

parameters.name: aspectRatio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio or pixel size.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Resolution level (1k, 2k).

parameters.name: imageCount
parameters.description: Number of generated images (Qwen uses n, Seedream 5.0 Lite images use sequential_image_generation_options.max_images).

parameters.name: watermark
parameters.description: Whether to add watermark.

parameters.name: providerOptions
parameters.description: Model personalized parameters (background, output_format, layer_decomposition, optimize_prompt_options, negative_prompt, prompt_extend).

providers.label: Yinshengyunshu one-computation asynchronous image task (WAND-Vega Image)

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: WAND-Vega asynchronous image model ID (such as wand-vega-image-pro, wand-vega-image-1.5-pro, wand-vega-image-flash).

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Image description prompt words.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: List of reference images (URL or Base64 Data URL, up to 14 images).

parameters.name: aspectRatio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio or pixel size.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Resolution levels (1k, 2k, 4k).

providers.label: Yinsheng Yunshu unified video generation (Seedance / Wan 3.0 / MiniMax H3 / WAND-Vega)

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Video model ID (such as doubao-seedance-2-0-260128, doubao-seedance-2-5-260628, wan3.0-video, minimax-h3, wand-vega-video-1.0-lite).

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Video prompt words.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: First frame (first_frame), last frame (last_frame), multi-modal reference image (reference_image).

parameters.name: videos
parameters.description: Reference video (reference_video).

parameters.name: audios
parameters.description: Reference audio (reference_audio).

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution gears (480P, 720P, 768P, 1080P, 2K, 4K).

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Video duration in seconds (Wan 3.0 supports 2-30 seconds, others support 4-15 seconds, Seedance supports -1 automatic duration).

parameters.name: generateAudio
parameters.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio (only models that support the audio switch are sent).

parameters.name: watermark
parameters.description: Whether to include a watermark (only models that support the watermark switch are sent).

parameters.name: providerOptions
parameters.description: Channel personalization parameters (Doubao: reference_mode / output_format / return_last_frame; Qwen: prompt_extend).
